Rachel Gomez: OK team — launching QuickStart Labs next month. Micro-launch series: 3 short webinars + 50 free credits + curated prompt packs. Primary goal: increase day-7 active rate for new signups by ~12% vs baseline. Need comms, tracking, and a clean inbound routing plan. :rocket:
Devin Patel: love the format. Segment = new signups in past 14 days, orgs < 25 seats? or include self-serve teams too?
Liam Chen: I'll take landing + webinar page. Recommend two headline angles to test.
Ana Morales: I'll set UTM + experiment flags. Devin — need the segment definition and event names for tracking. Also propose an 'engagement' tracking goal: >1 API call + >100 tokens used within 7 days.
Priya Singh: Can we include a 30-min 'starter lab' office hours 24-48h after each webinar for engineers who hit the credits? Helps convert demos.
Devin Patel: Segment = signups last 14d AND not passed to AE. Include both solo devs and small teams; we can stratify by initial token usage. Routing: if user redeems credits AND makes >3 API calls in 48h -> tag as product-qualified lead. Tag -> SDR queue.
Liam Chen: Draft email subject tests:
```
A) Jumpstart with 50 free credits — QuickStart Labs
B) Build a feature in 30 min + free credits 🎯
```
Which one should we A/B?
Rachel Gomez: A/B both. Use 50% split on the webinar invite cohort. Also social copy for Twitter + LinkedIn; short case snippet for tweets.
Ana Morales: Landing experiments: control = single CTA to register. Variant = register + prompt-pack checkout (download after reg). I'll wire both and surface conversion to /events/register and /downloads/prompt-pack.
Priya Singh: For the prompt packs: create 3 vertical-ish packs — snippets for search UX, customer support assistant, and code generation starter. Make them small (3-5 prompts) with quick usage guide.
Liam Chen: I'll write the copy and one short walkthrough GIF for each pack. Want to include inline examples in email too.
Devin Patel: Metrics to watch: registration rate, webinar attendance, credits redemption rate, day-1/3/7 active, API calls per user, prompt-pack downloads, PQL conversions. Baseline metrics sent in follow-up.
Rachel Gomez: Timeline: week 0: landing + email + webinar cadence; week 1-3: webinars weekly; week 1-4: follow-up nurture with micro-lessons. Need comms calendar + creative by EOD Friday.
calendar-bot: Event created: "QuickStart Labs — Week 1" on 2026-05-12 16:00 UTC
Ana Morales: Routing details for ops: create experiment flag quickstart_v1. UTMs: utm_campaign=quickstart_labs&utm_source=email&utm_medium=invite. Send payload to BI: event names = quickstart_invite, quickstart_attend, quickstart_redeem, quickstart_prompt_download.
Priya Singh: Can we gate larger credit (200) behind a follow-up goal for companies that show heavy usage? i.e., if org >3 devs and >10 API calls within 7d then upsell with 200-credit offer.
Devin Patel: Yep; that's the conversion play. Also add a soft-touch in-app message at day 2 for anyone who redeemed credits but hasn't made an API call.
Liam Chen: Copy suggestion for that in-app message: "Need a starter prompt? Try our 'Create a reply' template — takes 30s."
Rachel Gomez: Action items:
- Liam: landing, email, prompt-pack copy + GIFs (due Thu)
- Ana: UTMs, event tracking, experiment flag, routing to SDR (due Thu)
- Devin: segment definition + baseline metrics + PQL rule (due Wed)
- Priya: prompt-pack content + office-hours plan (due Thu)
- Rachel: webinar slides + comms calendar (due Fri)
Please drop calendar/event invites and PRD link here when ready. Keeping this short — post any blocks. :slightly_smiling_face:
